newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil slides $9.25 on technicals,spread play.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil slides $9.25 on technicals,spread play.

text.p: IPE gas oil slid $9.25 a tonne on Thursday, slipping below key resistance at $195.50 on technical factors and plays on the Feb/March spread, traders said.
"There was also a lot of liquidation of length...We're definitely trending lower," a trader said.
Front month Feb gas oil settled at $191.75, 50 cents above the day's low and $9.25 off the previous close.

March Brent crude oil futures were trading at $21.75 a barrel at 1816 GMT, down 72 cents on the day and six cents above the low, after slipping under the psychologically important $22 a barrel level for the first time in over four months.

Brent's dip at 1455 GMT followed a fall by the Feb gas oil contract below resistance at $195.50 a tonne. Some traders said fresh fund selling just before Brent's retreat gave impetus to its decline, which met rapid resistance at $21.65/75.
Prompt Brent futures have not fallen below $22 since September 23, 1996, when it touched a low of $21.83, although the front-month touched $22 on December 11 and January 27.
"Feb (gas oil) was pulled lower by spread play and once it fell through that 195.50 it pulled Brent down with it," one trader said.
Support for Brent was seen at $21.45, followed by $21.00.
Traders said that despite a squeeze on Feb gas oil has come under pressure from the large amount of material accumulated in the Rotterdam region and the closure of the arb to the United States.
